independence: Read all six accepted original ASCII files and created independent_expected.json before reading parsed JSON, review tables or parse_summary. Did not read or run tree_parser.py, parser snapshot, parser tests, previous-round reports, or excluded inputs. Directory names were listed during discovery, but excluded file contents were never inspected.
policy: Labels exclude drawn routing-wire graphics and retain full named inline reference annotations including arrow run lengths. Reference/workflow arrows are not containment edges. Detached ordinary prose bullet appendices after explicit trees are prose; standalone bullet trees, guided/indented lists within trees and appendices with explicit branch connectors are trees.
source_positions: 1-based lines, 0-based start columns in fixture/report; parser column converted from 1-based. Parsed raw_lines and end_line checked for every node; every source line and excluded line checked.

accepted_intent_alternatives_used: omit isolated LineGridScene reference target (predeclared alternative)
Legend as tree root (predeclared heading alternative)

ambiguities_and_source_interpretation_no.description: LineGridScene at column 55 is a separately drawn arrow target without its own explicit containment branches. Baseline includes a standalone root; omitting that isolated reference-only target is an accepted alternative. It must never become part of the MappingDocument label or its containment child.

GridContent is separately drawn at column 57; its first branch starts at column 60, others at 59. Despite the one-column wobble, id/ascii/revision/mappings are its children, sourceRanges is under mappings, and the two range fields are under sourceRanges. This relationship is clear; no unresolved parent alternative is accepted.

The two standalone --> lines indicate save workflow results. Baseline excludes them as reference annotations with no containment edges. A representation retaining them as non-containment annotation records is equivalent.

Legend is an underlined section heading. Baseline excludes heading and includes two connector entries as roots under the explicit-connector appendix policy. Treating Legend as a root parent is an accepted intent alternative; dropping the connector entries entirely is not the declared appendix policy.
